_doc: Canonical stage list for the broll-montage world (a folder of speechless clips -> one rhythmic montage). Read by scripts/run.py; mirrors docs/pipeline.md's montage diagram and SKILL.md's Montage-mode section. Same stage grammar as reel-speech.json. No transcription, no captions, no theme. `montage_mode.py plan` rewrites the plan[] array inside build/montage-plan.json in place, so it declares no `makes` and always re-runs (cheap, deterministic).

stages.title: Score every clip, pick each one's best moment
Contact sheet of the picked moments
Drop the shots the user doesn't want
stages.note: Show the numbered sheet to the user and ask what to remove. `montage_mode.py drop 4 11` / `keep 1 2 5 9` / `undo`. Nothing to cut -> continue. See SKILL.md, Montage mode step 3.
